verdict.rationale: Dropbox Dash provides AI-generated summaries, document insights/answers, review assistance, and AI-based organization directly on user content, as documented across multiple first-party resource pages (summarizing files, getting AI answers, organizing with AI, reviewing documents, reading PDFs). This directly matches the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from a user's own data inside the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Dash's AI quality, and detail on how deeply these insights integrate into core Dropbox storage vs. being a separate Dash product.
